KYB and UBO verification automation for business customers

A KYB agent reads the company documents, lists the beneficial owners above your threshold, screens each person and the company, and sends gaps in the ownership picture to a reviewer.

Book a demoSee how it runs

Works with

  • Custom REST

and any system with an API via Custom REST

What is KYB and UBO verification?

  • The procedure

    KYB checks a business customer: the company, the people who run it and the people who own or control it. UBO verification traces ownership through any holding companies until each owner above your threshold has a name, an ID and a screening result. Layered structures and undocumented owners are where the work slows down.

  • What the agent does

    • Reads the company documents and ownership declaration from Sumsub

    • Traces ownership through holding companies and lists owners above your threshold

    • Screens the company and each owner in ComplyAdvantage

    • Saves the ownership map to the case folder in Google Drive

  • What your team decides

    • Whether a layered or undocumented structure is acceptable

    • Whether an owner's possible sanctions match stands

    • Which extra documents to ask the customer for

    • Escalations to your MLRO or compliance officer

Setting up the KYB Review Agent

Connect your systems

Read company documents from Sumsub, screen the company and each owner in ComplyAdvantage, keep the ownership map in Google Drive, and reach registry or other systems through Custom REST.

  • Custom REST

Write the rules

Your ownership threshold and structure rules are CEL conditions. Any share that is not accounted for sends the case to a reviewer.

Sample data
ownership.unaccounted_share > 0Ask a reviewer
owners.exists(o, o.screening.hits > 0)Ask a reviewer
ownership.unaccounted_share == 0Approve

Add reviewers where the procedure says

When the ownership picture has a gap, the reviewer sees the map the agent built and decides what the procedure allows.

Sample data

Review requested: Corvid Freight

Reason
Holding company owners not documented
Rule
ownership.unaccounted_share > 0
Procedure
KYB review · v1.2

Accept structureRequest documents

Start it from the event

Start a KYB review when Sumsub finishes with a business applicant or a new business customer arrives by webhook. A daily schedule re-checks ownership requests still waiting on documents.

  • Sumsub · applicantReviewed
  • Inbound webhook · new business customer
  • Daily at 06:00 · ownership requests awaiting documents

Version and evaluate

Test each version against cases you define: a simple two-owner company, a layered holding structure and an owner with a screening hit. A failing case blocks publishing until it is fixed.

Questions about KYB and UBO verification

How does the agent handle a holding company?

It follows the ownership chain through each layer it has documents for. If part of the ownership is unaccounted for, a CEL rule sends the case to a reviewer with the map built so far.

Can we set our own ownership threshold?

Yes. The threshold is part of your procedure and its rules, so you set it and change it by publishing a new version.

Does it check company registries?

There is no built-in registry connector. If your registry provider has an API, the agent can call it through Custom REST.

Who sees the ownership map?

Reviewers see it when a run pauses, and it is saved to the case folder in Google Drive. Auditors can read it alongside the run.
